bio.es: Mary Elle Fanning (Conyers, Georgia, Estados Unidos; 9 de abril de 1998) es una actriz estadounidense. Comenzó su carrera como actriz infantil antes de cumplir tres años, interpretando la versión más joven del personaje de su hermana mayor, Dakota Fanning, en Yo soy Sam (2001). Durante su infancia apareció en producciones destacadas como Babel (2006), El curioso caso de Benjamin Button (2008), Somewhere (2010), de Sofia Coppola, y Super 8 (2011), dirigida por J. J. Abrams. Alcanzó reconocimiento mundial en el cine comercial al interpretar a la princesa Aurora en Maléfica (2014) y su secuela Maléfica: Maestra del mal (2019).

conocida: El curioso caso de Benjamin Button

bio.es: Hailee Steinfeld (11 de diciembre de 1996) es una actriz y cantante estadounidense. Tuvo algunos papeles en cortometrajes y series de televisión antes de interpretar a Mattie Ross en la adaptación de True Grit de los hermanos Coen, por la cual fue nominada al Óscar.

bio.en: Daniel Jonathan Stevens (born 10 October 1982) is an English actor. He first drew international attention for his role as Matthew Crawley in the ITV period drama series Downton Abbey (2010–2012). He also starred as David in the thriller film The Guest (2014), Sir Lancelot in the adventure film Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb (2014), The Beast/Prince in Disney's live-action adaptation of Beauty and the Beast (2017), Lorin Willis in the biographical legal drama Marshall (2017), Charles Dickens in the biographical drama The Man Who Invented Christmas (2017) and Russian Eurovision singer Alexander Lemtov in Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga (2020).

conocida: Noche en el museo: El secreto del faraón
Godzilla y Kong: El nuevo imperio

bio.en: Carlos González Fernández (born 24 May 1997) is a Spanish actor. Gonzalez studied acting at Estudio Corazza para la Actuación, the same school as fellow countryman Javier Bardem. Gonzalez had been acting in plays and shows, but hadn't made a debut in films until La Bola Negra (2026), playing Alberto. Gonzalez identifies as non-binary, and prefers both feminine and masculine pronouns.

conocida: Todas las veces que nos enamoramos

bio.en: Julio Torres (born February 11, 1987) is a Salvadoran-American writer, comedian, and actor. He is best known as a writer for Saturday Night Live and as the co-creator, writer, and executive producer of the HBO series Los Espookys. He previously wrote for The Chris Gethard Show on truTV.

conocida: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon

bio.en: María Gandiaga began her career at the age of seven with the musical “Sonrisas y Lágrimas” by the production company SOM Produce. In 2017, she began her audiovisual career, participating in short films such as “Como si con la comida se pudiera repartir cariño,” “La Pared de Gotelé Más Bonita del Mundo,” and “Epílogo,” among others, while continuing her training in Performing and Cinematic Arts. In 2026, she made her debut in her first feature film, “Ruega por nosotras,” directed by Daniel Monzón.

bio.es: Elena Anaya (nacida el 17 de julio de 1975) es una actriz española cuya carrera se remonta a 1995. Anaya nació en Palencia, España, el 17 de julio de 1975. Es la menor de 5 hijos. Recibió atención internacional por primera vez en 2001 por su papel en el drama sexualmente explícito Lucía y el sexo (Sex and Lucía) y también apareció en Hable con ella (Hable con ella) de Pedro Almodóvar. Su papel más conocido en la película de Hollywood fue como vampiro en 2004 en Van Helsing, interpretando a la novia de Drácula, Aleera. También aparece en el video musical de Justin Timberlake para su single de 2006, SexyBack.

bio.en: Rodrigo Sorogoyen del Amo (born 16 September 1981) is a Spanish film director and screenwriter. He won the Goya Award for Best Director and the Goya Award for Best Original Screenplay for The Realm. He was previously nominated for the Goya Award for Best New Director for Stockholm, the Goya Award for Best Director, and the Goya Award for Best Original Screenplay for May God Save Us. For the short film Mother, Sorogoyen won the Goya Award for Best Fictional Short Film and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film. He often works in tandem with Isabel Peña. Born on 16 September 1981 in Madrid, Rodrigo Sorogoyen is the grandson of filmmaker Antonio del Amo.

descripcion.ca: director i guionista de cinema espanyol

bio.ca: Victoria Luengo més coneguda com a Vicky Luengo (Palma, 7 d'abril de 1990) és una actriu nascuda a Mallorca, que va viure a Barcelona dels 4 als 18 anys. Va començar a fer teatre com a activitat extraescolar alhora que estudiava educació primària. Més tard va estar en una escola d'interpretació especialitzada (Escola Memory, a Barcelona). La primera vegada que va pujar a l'escenari de manera professional va ser amb 14 anys. El 2015 va ser guardonada al Festival Internacional de Cinema de la Ciutat de Nova York com a millor actiu principal en la pel·lícula Born de Claudio Zulian. El 2023 va ser guardonada amb el premi Gaudí a la millor actriu protagonista.

bio.en: Rizwan Ahmed (born 1 December 1982) is a British actor and rapper. He has received several awards, including an Academy Award and a Primetime Emmy Award, and nominations for two Golden Globe Awards and two British Academy Film Awards. In 2017, he was named by Time as one of the most influential people in the world. He also created the TV series Englistan in 2018 for the BBC, which was also his writing debut. After studying acting at the Royal Central School of Speech and Drama, Ahmed began his acting career with independent films such as The Road to Guantanamo (2006), Shifty (2008), Four Lions (2010), Trishna (2011), and The Reluctant Fundamentalist (2012).

conocida: Rogue One: Una historia de Star Wars

bio.en: Rod Paradot (born 1996) is a French actor. He won the César Award for Most Promising Actor in 2016 for his role in Standing Tall. Source: Article "Rod Paradot" from Wikipedia in English, licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0.

Rebecca Antonaci, born in 2004, actress, dancer, performer, musician, singer-songwriter, active in theatre, cinema and television. From a very early age Rebecca shows a strong talent for the performing arts. Directed by her parents towards performative arts studies, from the age of 6 Rebecca attends singing, dance, musical performance and piano lessons. She is the protagonist of the new film by Saverio Costanzo: "Finalmente L'alba" (soon to be released), alongside actors such as Lily James, Joe Kerry and Willem Dafoe, production Fremantle/ Wildside. Over the years her talent grows, bringing her to aspire to artistic excellence.

Lambert Wilson (born August 3, 1958) is a French actor, singer, and activist. He is best known internationally for his portrayal of The Merovingian in The Matrix Reloaded, The Matrix Revolutions, and The Matrix Resurrections.

bio.es: Director, guionista y productor estadounidense nacido en Brooklyn, Nueva York. De familia judía, decidió convertirse en cineasta desde su juventud. Estudió en la Universidad de Harvard y pasó brevemente por el American Film Institute. En este período educativo dirigió sus cortos Supermarket Sweep (1991), Fortune Cookie (1991) y Protozoa (1993). El largometraje debut de Aronofsky fue Pi (1998), una intriga psicológica con trazos surrealistas filmada en blanco y negro que contaba con el protagonismo de un matemático llamado Max Cohen. De tonos alucinatorios y paranoicos, la película, co-escrita entre Aronofsky, Sean Gullette y Eric Watson, tenía influencias de David Lynch.

bio.en: Ewa Fröling (born Eva Marie Fröling; August 9, 1952) is a Swedish actress. She is internationally most recognized for her leading parts in Gunnel Lindblom's Sally och friheten (as Sally) and Ingmar Bergman's Fanny and Alexander (as Emelie). bio.es: Akio Otsuka (大塚 明夫, Ō tsuka Akio) es un actor de doblaje (seiyu) japonés de Tokio que está afiliado a Mausu Promotion. Es hijo del también actor de doblaje Chikao Otsuka. En febrero de 2005, se casó con la actriz de doblaje Yoko Soumi, pero se divorció de ella en 2009.

Jorge López es un actor, cantante y bailarín chileno. Nació el 30 de octubre de 1990 en Llay-Llay, San Felipe de Aconcagua. Desde niño, López demostró su talento para la danza, aunque su vocación también fue por la actuación. A los 16 años, decidió convertirse definitivamente en actor, estudiando interpretación en la Academia de Arte Dramático Fernando González Mardones y en la Universidad de Artes, Ciencias y Comunicación de Santiago de Chile.

bio.en: Venci Kostov is a director and writer, known for Liuben, Through a Boy's Eyes (2018) and La Zaranda, teatro inestable (2020).

Nagore Aranburu is a Spanish stage, film and television actress, screenwriter and director, best known for her leading role in the feature film Flowers as well as for her work in theatre (not to be confused with model Nagore Aranburu, wife of former Spanish footballer Xavier Alonso).

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Russell Mulcahy (born 23 June 1953 in Melbourne, Victoria) is an Australian film director. His work is easily recognized by his use of fast cuts, tracking shots and use of glowing lights. Description above from the Wikipedia article Russell Mulcahy, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

Christophe Guy Denis "Christopher" Lambert (born 29 March 1957) is an American-born French actor who has appeared in American, as well as French and other European productions. He is best known for his role as Connor MacLeod, or simply "The Highlander", from the movie and subsequent movie franchise series of the same name. He is also known for his roles as Tarzan in Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes and as the thunder god Raiden in the first movie adaptation of the video game Mortal Kombat. He is credited internationally as Christopher Lambert, with the exceptions of French-speaking countries, where he is known as Christophe Lambert.

bio.ca: Roxanne Hart (Trenton, Nova Jersey, 27 de juliol de 1952) és una actriu nord-americana, coneguda pels seus papers com a Brenda Wyatt a la pel·lícula Highlander de 1986 i com a infermera Camille Shutt a la sèrie de drama mèdic de la CBS Chicago Hope. Hart va rebre una nominació al premi Tony pel seu treball escènic.

bio.en: Jon Polito (born December 29, 1950 — September 1, 2016) was an American actor. In a career spanning 35 years and over 220 film and television credits, he became best known for his work with the Coen Brothers, most notably as the Italian gangster Johnny Caspar in Miller's Crossing. He also appeared in the first two seasons of Homicide: Life on the Street and on the first season of Crime Story.

conocida: En el corredor de la muerte

bio.en: Lux Balmaceda Pascal (born June 4, 1992) is an American and Chilean actress and transgender activist. She is known for her roles in the Chilean television series Veinteañero a los 40 and "uana Brava, as well as the Chilean drama film The Prince. Description above from the Wikipedia article Lux Pascal, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

bio.es: Hayao Miyazaki (Miyazaki Hayao, nacido el 5 de enero de 1941) es un dibujante de manga japonés y un destacado director de cine y animador de muchos largometrajes de anime populares. A lo largo de una carrera de casi cinco décadas, Miyazaki ha alcanzado la fama internacional como realizador de largometrajes de animación y, junto con Isao Takahata, cofundó Studio Ghibli, un estudio de animación y una productora. El éxito de las películas de Miyazaki ha hecho que se le compare con el animador estadounidense Walt Disney, el británico Nick Park y Robert Zemeckis, pionero de la animación por captura de movimiento, y ha sido nombrado una de las personas más influyentes por la revista Time.

bio.en: **Naveen Kumar Gowda** (born 8 January 1986), known mononymously by his screen name **Yash**, is an Indian actor who primarily works in Kannada films. Widely referred to in the media as the "Rocking Star," he is one of the highest-paid and most bankable actors in the Kannada film industry. Born in Bhuvanahalli, a village in the Hassan district of Karnataka, to a father who worked as a KSRTC and BMTC bus driver, Yash spent his childhood in Mysore. He completed his pre-university education at Mahajana Education Society before pursuing a Bachelor of Arts at K.L.E. College in Bangalore.

bio.en: Arun Govil (born 12 January 1958) is an Indian actor and politician. He is best known for portraying Lord Rama in the 1987 Ramayan TV series and reprising his role (voice acting) in the 1993 animated film, Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama. He also appeared in films like Paheli (1977), Sawan Ko Aane Do (1979), Saanch Ko Aanch Nahin (1979), Jiyo To Aise Jiyo (1981), Himmatwala (1983), Dilwaala (1986), and Govinda Govinda (1994).

She has been employed by Oslo's Det Norske Teatret since 2004 where she has appeared in a number of productions and acted for Norwegian television. bio.es: Escritora. Me interesé por el mundo del teatro desde pequeña. Primero como espectadora, después empecé clases de interpretación, y con 18 años me apunté a mi primer curso de dramaturgia en la Sala Beckett. Sin duda, Javier Daulte y Sergi Belbel, fueron los profesores que más me marcaron. Por aquel entonces estudiaba filología hispánica y pronto lo dejé para pasarme al Institut del Teatre de Barcelona, dónde me licencié en Dirección y Dramaturgia. Aún no había terminado y estrené en el Teatre Versus de Barcelona, dos obras a la vez. Una en horario de tarde y la otra de noche.

Muntsa Alcañiz (Constantí, Tarragonès, 4 de Mayo de 1954) es una actriz y profesora de interpretación de l'Institut del Teatre de la Diputación de Barcelona. El año 1985 fue galardonada con el Premio Margarida Xirgu.
